checks: 12 distinct goals, four early/six middle/two final modules; PV 2/3/4; bonus +2 and two-trick minimum.
Every goal rejects an empty sequence and a single card, including one expensive Epic.
Îlot: two legal tricks without tokens earn +2; spending a token on an unused die removes the bonus.
Quai bas: same face across different cards earns +2; two different pairs without a shared face do not.
Stars keep their physical value 1 for module goals, even when the personal joker resolves as 3.
Petite Vague: Base immediately followed by Advanced earns +2, including a three-die Advanced.
Rail des Palmiers: strict printed score order; equal or descending scores fail, conditional effects do not change ordering.
Retour du Rail: preserve own-color die for the last trick; mandatory two types remain enforced.
Tour de l’Îlot: freeze during one trick persists through Continue and the next roll; using that retained die earns +2.
Freeze triggered at the decision commits continuation and can protect against a reroll in the following trick.
Freeze immediately used, or only protected by a reroll within the same trick, does not count as a cross-trick freeze.
Coping Bleu: failed first roll plus real reroll and landed trick earns +2; rerolling an already possible trick earns nothing.
A player cannot manufacture an initially failed roll using ±1 and then claim the rescue bonus.
Double Quai: two within-card pairs qualify even without a shared face; a pair plus unequal dice fails.
Double Quai also accepts repeated physical faces inside three-die cards; it does not require two-die tricks.
Marches: both physical Pop Shuvit copies activate independently; module +2, card +2 and third-trick +1 are separate.
Token rewards and the third-trick reward cannot masquerade as two card point effects.
Embruns: exactly two two-die cards earn +2; a third card removes that bonus while earning its own third-trick point.
Embruns rewards an automatically banked two-card sequence when no card remains playable.
Boucle du Lagon: a four-die Epic can finish after a Base; an Epic followed by a Base does not qualify.
Grande Vague: 2+2+2, 3+3, 4+2 and 2+4 all qualify; one card or only five dice does not.
A fall cancels the entire attempt and module bonus; an impossible second mandatory type forces a fall.
Save/restore between frozen tricks preserves evidence; speculative NPC placements cannot mutate actual history.
The two-trick minimum rejects otherwise matching historical evidence from a different attempt.
A promising pair forecast informs planning but awards no actual module points without landed physical dice.
